title: Vacuum the living room

steps.text: Pick up toys, papers, and charging cords.
steps.tip: Vacuum eats small things. Look first.

steps.text: Ask a grown-up to show the on switch and the cord.

steps.tip: Start at the far corner and walk toward the door.

steps.text: Turn it off, wrap the cord, put it away.
steps.tip: Check corners and under the coffee table.

done_when: Cords and toys are not left in a heap
parent_notes: grown_up_required for power and stairs. Stick vacuum is easier than an upright for some kids.
